run_poisson_reconstruct: run poisson_reconstruct with grady, gradx, and boundarysrc numpy arrays to reconstruct an image
test_poisson_reconstruct: test poisson_reconstruct by passing synthetic gradient fields and a boundary image
review_poisson_reconstruct: review poisson_reconstruct to understand the discrete sine transform based Poisson image reconstruction algorithm
summarize_poisson_reconstruct: summarize poisson_reconstruct which uses DST and eigenvalue decomposition for fast Poisson image reconstruction
refactor_poisson_reconstruct: refactor poisson_reconstruct to replace deprecated scipy.fftpack with scipy.fft for modern scipy compatibility
